title: Solo dev + Opus 5.5
author: Civil-Ad-7646
selftext:
Hi! I've been working on Beyond the Cradle, a factory game where you start on one small planet and slowly scale up to building a star engine across nine worlds. I used Claude Opus 5.5 as a coding agent. Art has been harder than code.

It's still far from finished; I'm posting mostly to collect honest feedback :)  
  
a wishlist helps a lot if it looks interesting! [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4464270/Beyond\_the\_Cradle/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4464270/Beyond_the_Cradle/)

comments.author: ThreeDMK
comments.body: Wishlist added.  I hope it gets to launch.  Dyson Sphere w/ Astroneer style?  Sold.

comments.body: Cool concept! I like the look of it. But night time trees don't really mesh with the ground.
